assertion_results.text: Sibling check correctly classifies TC-8001 as a different-stream companion (stream [rhtpa-2.2] vs current issue's [rhtpa-2.1]), not a same-stream duplicate (Step 4)
assertion_results.evidence: sibling-check.md states: 'TC-8001 has stream suffix [rhtpa-2.2] (2.2.x stream). TC-8006 has stream suffix [rhtpa-2.1] (2.1.x stream). These are different streams.' Classification: 'Different-stream sibling (companion tracker) -- not a duplicate.'

assertion_results.text: Step 4.2 checks the current issue's existing issuelinks before attempting to create a 'Related' link to TC-8001 (§1.58)
assertion_results.evidence: sibling-check.md 'Link Idempotency Check' section: 'Before creating a link, Step 4.2 requires checking the current issue's issuelinks array for an existing link that satisfies all of: type.name is Related, inwardIssue.key or outwardIssue.key matches the sibling key (TC-8001)'. It then lists the existing links on TC-8006 from Step 1 data extraction and checks against them.

assertion_results.text: Step 4.2 detects the pre-existing 'Related' link to TC-8001 and skips link creation — does NOT call jira.create_link (§1.58)
assertion_results.evidence: sibling-check.md: 'Check result: A link with type.name = Related and outwardIssue.key = TC-8001 already exists (Link ID 1990401). Action: Skip link creation.' triage-outcome.md confirms: 'Step 4.2 skipped the jira.create_link() call.'

assertion_results.text: The output includes a log message indicating the link was skipped because it already exists (e.g., 'Related link to TC-8001 already exists — skipping')
assertion_results.evidence: sibling-check.md contains: 'Log message: > Related link to TC-8001 already exists -- skipping'. triage-outcome.md also quotes: 'Related link to TC-8001 already exists -- skipping'.

assertion_results.text: The sibling landscape table is still presented to the engineer despite the link already existing — the idempotent check only affects link creation, not the sibling summary
assertion_results.evidence: sibling-check.md includes a 'Sibling Landscape' section with a table showing TC-8001 (2.2.x, In Progress) and TC-8006 (2.1.x, New) after the link skip. triage-outcome.md confirms: 'Presented the sibling landscape table showing both companion issues.'
